draft.text: You came in to talk about your back pain and increased nighttime urination.
We found that you have back pain on your left side, which is mostly a dull ache but sometimes sharp.
You also have more urination at night, but no trouble with your urinary stream or difficulty urinating.
You have not had any recent injuries or family history of back issues.
You have not had any imaging or urological tests done yet.
You are to have a CT scan of your lumbar spine, kidneys, and urinary tract as ordered by your primary care doctor.
You will need to provide the results of the CT scan once it is available for further evaluation.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having back pain on your left side.
The pain is mostly a dull ache, but sometimes it feels sharp.
You also mentioned that you are going to the bathroom more often at night.
We did not find any recent injuries or family history of back problems.
There were no tests or exams done during this visit.
Your back pain and increased nighttime urination could be related to several possible causes.
